title: The Carrot Night Vision Propaganda Lie
hook: Britain told the world carrots gave pilots night vision.

scenes.text: In 1940, British night fighter pilots suddenly began shooting down German bombers in total pitch-black darkness with uncanny precision.
scenes.imagePrompt: Dark night sky over the English coast with searchlight beams slicing through black clouds and distant anti-aircraft flashes. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: In 1940, British night fighter pilots suddenly began shooting down German bombers in total pitch-black darkness with uncanny precision.

scenes.text: In reality, the RAF had secretly installed top-secret Airborne Interception radar units into twin-engine Bristol Beaufighter cockpits.
scenes.imagePrompt: Vintage twin-engine British Beaufighter fighter aircraft parked inside an airfield hangar with radar antenna arrays visible on the nose. 2D flat cartoon illustration, thick dark outlines, warm muted palette, hand-painted textures, vertical 9:16, no people in the foreground, no text, no logos
scenes.voicedText: In reality, the RAF had secretly installed top-secret Airborne Interception radar units into twin-engine Bristol Beaufighter cockpits.

scenes.text: To hide the radar breakthrough from German intelligence, the British Air Ministry launched a brilliant propaganda cover story.

scenes.text: They claimed fighter ace John 'Cat's Eyes' Cunningham possessed superhuman night vision because he ate bowls of raw carrots every day.
